verdict_on_gap:
The brief overstates the gap. 'Every workflow framework we found assumes the decisions come first' is false as of October 2026, and the README should not repeat it.

- GSD, the largest Claude Code workflow framework (about 64k stars), has shipped /gsd:spike since April 2026. It runs risk-ordered throwaway experiments with kill-first ordering, verdicts, pivots noted per spike, 'design decisions that emerged from the user's choices during spiking', and a wrap-up that hands findings to the real build.
- hordev (September 2026, in the official directory) is built on exactly the 'trades interviewing for building' stance. It has no approval gate, an assumption ledger for every unasked question, and 2-4 racing prototypes in sibling worktrees under identical budgets with judging criteria committed in advance.

Each remaining piece also has a near neighbor:
- Supersession and rejected paths: Continuity.
- Recovering decisions from the transcript, plus SessionStart compact re-injection: session-recharge, Continuity, superstack.
- After-the-fact decision recovery with a three-way stated/inferred/testimony provenance that is almost scout's code/operator/open: why-log.
- Pre-registered GO/KILL thresholds: antiagree.

What I could not find anywhere is the integration:
- One question with an hours-plus-dollars box metered from capped claude -p spawns.
- Kill criteria on the question itself.
- Questions parked and raised only at boundaries, rather than GSD's mid-flow CHECKPOINTs.
- Pivots that mark earlier decisions superseded in place.
- Decisions recovered at close from both the diff and the transcript, tagged operator/code/open with pointers.
- A tool-neutral handoff that maps onto a ledger provenance enum and carries optional pre-registration for a scored track.

So the gap is real but narrow. It is not 'nobody does exploration mode'. It is 'nobody does budgeted, provenance-tagged decision recovery from exploration and hands it to a spec-driven intake'.

Recommendations:
- Reposition the README against GSD spike and hordev explicitly, and name the differentiators: dollar-metered box, park-don't-ask, recovery with operator/code/open provenance, and a spec-intake handoff.
- Consider borrowing proven ideas: hordev's 'keep losing branches until the human has seen them', why-log's verbatim-quote gate for 'operator' provenance, and antiagree's 'can't move the bar after the result' framing for pre-registration.

What I could not find anywhere is the specific combination: an hours-plus-dollars box metered from spawn costs, a scout-level kill rule, an ordered direction list where a pivot is the common path and supersedes earlier decisions in place, decisions tagged operator/code/open and recovered from the diff as well as the transcript, a fixed-heading markdown handoff written for a spec-driven intake's provenance enum, 2-4 arms each a capped claude -p in sibling worktrees, and transcript paths recorded as pointers for the successor. Bearings: keep building, but rewrite the positioning to name GSD /gsd-spike and the handoff-plugin family as the things scout-ahead differs from, and consider reading the agent-lab-kit ledger/retraction mechanics and passbaton's 'Decided by / Source / Replaces' table as convergent designs worth aligning vocabulary with.

## 4. Bearings, feature by feature

- **Box + kill criteria.** Hours box: exists in bigpowers `spike-prototype` (https://github.com/danielvm-git/bigpowers), gamedev `prototype-fast` (https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills), HASH `ln-spike` (https://github.com/hashintel/brunch), the DEV.to kill-switch post. Kill criteria frozen before the build: exists in prp-spike (https://github.com/Wirasm/prp/blob/main/.agents/skills/prp-spike/SKILL.md), gamedev `prototype-fast` (KEEP IF / KILL IF), antiagree (https://github.com/antiagree/antiagree). Dollar box metered from spawn costs: **novel** as a composition; the cap itself exists natively as `claude -p --max-budget-usd` (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/checkpointing.md set, best-practices "How much it spends").
- **Pivot / supersession.** Supersession left in place with its reason: exists in Continuity (`supersedes`/`superseded_by`/`superseded_reason`, https://github.com/vikcena01/ai-continuity-plugin), agent-lab-kit retraction tags (https://github.com/Campanadas/agent-lab-kit), madr-gen bidirectional `supersedes` (https://github.com/JiHongKim98/madr-gen), passbaton "Replaces / invalidated" column, HASH `ln-spec` "supersession note", hordev per-assumption "superseded by". Pivot as a first-class boundary of a multi-direction loop: closest is GSD's Continue/Pivot/Abandon checkpoint with "Note the pivot in the README" (https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core); nobody marks superseded decisions at the pivot. Cheap undo exists natively as `/rewind`, `/branch`, `--fork-session`. Verdict: **novel only in the combination** (ordered directions + supersession marked at pivot).
- **No asking mid-build.** Exists in spikekit `/spike-goal` (park as a pending-decision card with a `TODO(pending-decision: <id>)` stub, https://github.com/gongxh13/spikekit), prp-spike unattended ("record the interpretation chosen and the alternatives rejected, and proceed"), hordev ("Announced, Not Asked"). Parking to a boundary and printing the parked list at pivot/close is scout's specific twist; spikekit's board is the nearest. **Not novel.**
- **Decision recovery with provenance.** Post-hoc recovery from JSONL + diff: exists in madr-gen. Three-way provenance: exists in why-log (`code|testimony|unknown`, https://github.com/oh-namgyu/why-log — refuted as prior art for the plugin, but the enum is a near one-to-one of code/operator/open), antiagree session audit ("Introduced by (user / you) | Verified?"), prp-spike (`proved`/`inferred` + seat), Continuity (confidence). Recovery at a direction's close, tagged operator/code/open with file:line / commit / quote pointers: **novel as a combination**; every piece exists separately.
- **Handoff format.** Fixed-section handoff for a successor: exists in agent-lab-kit HANDOFF.md, bigpowers SPIKE note, HASH `ln-handoff`, GSD wrap-up skill, spikekit `design.md`, agent-kit `SPIKE.md` Handoff section, prp-spike `references/handoff.md`; pointer-not-copy: Pocock `/handoff` (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills). Pre-registration: exists in agent-lab-kit `labkit prereg`, prp-spike (metric fixed before any variant exists), antiagree thresholds. A tool-neutral file that states its mapping onto a ledger provenance enum so settled decisions are not re-asked, carrying optional pre-registration: **novel**; the "distill" step between spike and spec tool has no tooling anywhere found.
- **Variants in worktrees with caps.** Exists in hordev `racing-prototypes` (2-4, own worktree, equal token budget set beforehand, criteria first, losers kept; https://github.com/heffrey/hordev); commodity in Cursor best-of-N (https://cursor.com/blog/agent-best-practices) and Codex `--attempts 2–4`; worktree-per-spike in prp-spike and ultracode-factory. Each arm a separate `claude -p` with CLI-enforced `--max-budget-usd` in sibling worktrees: **novel composition**, built from native `--worktree` and `--max-budget-usd`.
- **Compaction hook.** Exists natively in Claude Code as the SessionStart `compact` matcher (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/context-window); used by Continuity, passbaton (hardened: transcript-uuid gating, https://github.com/leesgit/claude-session-continuity-mcp), agent-lab-kit, session-recharge, timebox. Re-injecting the open scout's state specifically: closest Continuity `resume_context`. **Not novel.**
- **Transcript pointer.** Transcript read by path: madr-gen, the deleted manifest-dev `/adr`; transcript uuid stored and gated: passbaton; path references in a handoff: Pocock `/handoff`. Recording transcript paths in scout state for the successor: not found as such, but it is a few lines over a documented hook payload; call it **unclaimed, not novel**.

## 5. Recommendations (ranked)

1. **Rewrite README paragraph 2 now.** Replace "Every workflow framework we found assumes the decisions come first" with something like: spike modes exist inside spec-first frameworks (GSD, PRP, HASH Ln, superpowers) and a few tools reject the up-front spec outright (spikekit, hordev); all of them are one question → one verdict → feed a spec, and none runs exploration as a boxed, multi-pivot loop whose decisions are recovered with provenance and handed to a different tool. Drop the "comparison sites literally say" sentence unless the brief can produce the URL.
2. **Add a "Prior art" section to the README** citing, in this order: spikekit (same thesis), Wirasm/prp `prp-spike` (a reviewer who knows PRP will ask), GSD `/gsd:spike` (open-gsd/gsd-core URL, 11k stars), hordev `racing-prototypes` + `assumption-ledger`, Pocock `/prototype` + `/handoff`, Continuity. State the differentiators in one line each: dollar-metered box from capped spawns, park-to-boundary, close-time recovery tagged operator/code/open with pointers, supersession marked at pivot, tool-neutral handoff with the enum mapping and pre-registration.
3. **Borrow from prp-spike before shipping v1.** Read its `references/evidence.md` and `references/handoff.md`; consider a `proved`/`inferred` sub-label on `code` decisions (a file:line is proved; a constraint the model inferred from reading is not) and the "seat" idea for variant comparisons.
4. **Align the ledger vocabulary.** `decisions.md` and the handoff Decisions table should use `supersedes` / `superseded by` the way Continuity, madr-gen and MADR do, so a MADR reader needs no mapping; keep the handoff-format's stated mapping (`user-answered` / `codebase-derived` / `deferred`) and add `code|testimony|unknown` (why-log) as a second documented alias.
5. **Harden `operator` provenance with why-log's rule**: an `operator` tag requires a verbatim quote or a transcript pointer, otherwise it is `open`. That is already implied by rule 4; make the script enforce it.
6. **Harden the hook with passbaton's gating**: store the transcript uuid the hook last saw and skip re-injecting a scout whose last session already moved past it, so a stale "open scout" is never presented as current after a compaction in another session.
7. **Add a `cover`-style check at `/scout:handoff`** (agent-lab-kit): diff the rendered handoff against `state.json` and refuse to emit if a decision id or pointer dropped.
8. **Name a downstream reader and ship an adapter**: a short "how `/gsd:plan-phase` / superpowers `brainstorming` / intake-toolkit reads `handoff.md`" doc, since the "distill" seam is the only genuinely unoccupied spot. agent-ab is the natural "scored track" consumer of the Pre-registration section; say so.
9. **Keep hordev's rule in `/scout:variants`**: never delete a losing arm's worktree before the operator has seen the comparison (check whether the script already guarantees this; hordev states it explicitly).
10. **Get listed where the archaeology lenses looked**: prp-spike was missed by every directory/marketplace scan because it is outside the Anthropic plugin directory. The inverse applies to scout-ahead: submit to the directory, or expect to be invisible to the same searches.
11. **Naming**: `scout` is unclaimed in every listing fetched. `/scout:variants` is a best-of-N; the README should say so and name the difference (compared as evidence by the operator, not auto-selected). "Pre-registration" matches agent-lab-kit and antiagree usage; keep it.
